ALPHA GUIDE 
Page 20 of 76 
 
 
Why is the cross the symbol of Christianity? 
 
“... the Son of God... loved me and gave 
himself for me.”  
(GALATIANS 2:20) 
 
 
1. THE PROBLEM  
“All have sinned and fall short of the glory of God.” (Romans 3:23). 
• Pollution of sin (Mark 7:20–23) 
• Power of sin (John 8:34) 
• Penalty for sin (Romans 6:23) 
• Partition of sin (Isaiah 59:2) 
 
 
Therefore, you are without excuse, every one of you who passes judgment. For by the 
standard by which you judge another you condemn yourself, since you, the judge, do the very 
same things.  (Romans 2:1) 
 
 
2. THE SOLUTION  
• “The self-substitution of God” (1 Peter 2:24) 
• Agony of the cross (Isaiah 53:6)
